verdict.rationale: Evidence shows Zep's underlying temporal knowledge graph framework, Graphiti, is open-source on GitHub, and community comments thank the team for 'open sourcing this,' but the core Zep memory service itself is offered as a hosted Cloud/VPC product with no license or repo link given for the main platform. missing for 10: explicit license/repo for the core Zep server, confirmation that the full product (not just the Graphiti component) is open source, independent verification of license terms.
